title: tapeworm config
description: A tapeworm recording: which page, what viewport, and the scroll script to film. Mirrors the Config type in src/types.ts, which remains the source of truth.

$schema.description: URL or path of this schema, for editor validation. Ignored by the renderer.

url.description: The page to record. Required unless the timeline's start step carries a url; if both are present they must agree.

fps.description: Frames per second. Default 60 — scroll is the worst case for temporal aliasing.

timeline.description: The scroll script: legacy segments and typed steps, mixed freely. Required unless "auto" is set.

auto.description: With no timeline, discover candidate sections automatically and march through them.

path.description: Default "out.mp4". An extensionless path gets .mp4/.mov appended; a png render is a directory.

codec.description: h264 = CRF 12 yuv444p, plays everywhere. prores = ProRes 4444 editing master. png = numbered frame sequence in a directory. Default: inferred from the path extension, else h264.

crf.description: Override the x264 CRF. Lower = better. Default 12.

mode.description: full = step-scroll everything then film (clean, shardable; the default). cache = fill the HTTP cache, reload, film reveals on camera (jobs: 1). none = film a cold page (jobs: 1).

maxHeight.description: Give up past this document height in px. Default 60000.

timeout.description: Give up past this many wall-clock ms. Default 30000.

imageBudget.description: Longest a frame waits for images still loading, in ms. Default 400 (full) / 1500 (cache, none).

dismissConsent.description: Try to dismiss cookie/consent dialogs (prefers "reject"). Default true.

hideOverlays.description: Remove late-appearing fixed overlays (newsletter modals, chat widgets). Default true.

clock.description: virtual overrides Date.now/performance.now/rAF/timers so JS animation follows the frame index. Default "virtual".

seekAnimations.description: Pause and seek CSS/WAAPI animations per frame. Default true.

seedRandom.description: Stub Math.random with a seeded PRNG so a randomised page films the same every run. true = seed 42, or pass an integer seed. Reseeded per frame from (seed, frame time), so sharding survives. Default off.

embeds.description: Same modes for YouTube/Vimeo iframes, via their postMessage APIs — best-effort and keyframe-coarse. Defaults to "video"'s value. "sync" forces jobs: 1.

css.description: Extra CSS injected before the page's own scripts run.

script.description: Extra JS injected before the page's own scripts run.

settle.description: Wait this many ms after load before doing anything. Default 0.

waitForIntro.description: Longest to wait for intro/preloader animations to finish before filming, in ms. 0 disables. Default 8000.

replayIntro.description: true rewinds already-running animations to 0 at capture start, replaying the intro on camera. Default false.

unlockIntro.description: When the page isn't scrollable after load (scroll-gated intro), send real wheel events until it is. Default on.

maxTicks.description: Most wheel events to send. Default 40.

deltaY.description: Wheel delta per event, in px. Default 400.

substitute.description: Substitute assets during the render by intercepting their requests. The page never sees the switch.

localStorage.description: Seed the page's localStorage before its scripts run (top frame, config url's origin only). Values must be strings — what localStorage stores.

frame.description: Sample a single frame as one PNG instead of rendering the video: seconds into the timeline (2.5) or a percent of it ("50%"). The object form adds accuracy, trading determinism for speed on path-dependent timelines.

at.description: Seconds into the timeline (2.5) or a percent of it ("50%").

accuracy.description: exact = walk every frame before the sample (default; pixel-identical to a full render). segment = restart at the last full-page navigation at or before the sample. jump = also step the walk on the virtual clock alone and replay only recorded clicks, not pointer movement.

trim.description: Cut milliseconds off the ends of the finished video. The timeline is still planned (and walked) in full.

start.description: Milliseconds removed from the start. Default 0.

end.description: Milliseconds removed from the end. Default 0.

jobs.description: Parallel browser processes. Default min(4, cores − 1). Forced to 1 by prewarm cache/none, click/hover/record steps, and sync-mode provider embeds.

chromePath.description: Path to a Chrome / chrome-headless-shell binary. Default: auto-detect.

meta.description: Provenance stamped by authoring tools (authoredWith, authoredAt, authoredViewport, url). Free-form; ignored by the renderer.

headful.description: Show the browser window. Useful for debugging a page that fights you.

dpr.description: Device pixel ratio, integer 1–4. Use 2 or 3 — never 1 or fractional. Default 2.

videoMode.description: sync = seek every <video> to the frame's timestamp (the default). freeze = pause on the poster/first frame. ignore = leave them on the wall clock (they'll look wrong).

anchor.description: Where to scroll to: a keyword, a raw pixel offset, or an element anchor.

selector.description: CSS selector, resolved at capture time.

align.description: Where the element sits in the viewport. Default "top".

offset.description: Pixels added after alignment. Negative = breathing room above. Default 0.

nth.description: Which match to use if the selector matches several. Default 0.

fallbackText.description: A snippet of the element's text at author time. Never used to find the element — only to improve the error when the selector matches nothing.

ease.description: A named easing, or a raw CSS cubic-bezier as [x1, y1, x2, y2]. "natural" is a flick-scroll: brief ramp to peak velocity, then friction decay.

cursor.description: The cursor drawn during recorded-gesture replay (screenshots never contain the real pointer). true = the built-in arrow, false = none. Give only one of auto / dot / image.

auto.description: The bundled macOS cursor set, switching sprite per frame with the CSS cursor under the pointer.

dot.description: The preview-style touch disc, centred on the point.

image.description: Your own sprite: a local image path (png/svg/gif/jpeg/webp), or an https:// or data: URL.

tip.description: [x, y] px inside the rendered sprite where the pointer tip sits. Requires image. Default [0, 0].

size.description: Rendered width in CSS px (the dot's diameter; auto scales the whole set off the arrow's width).

fade.description: Seconds the sprite fades in/out instead of popping. Default 0.

from.description: URL wildcard pattern (* matches any run of characters, ? any single one) matched against the full request URL.

to.description: The replacement: an https URL, or a local file path served with Range support. Substituted videos need the moov atom up front (ffmpeg -movflags +faststart).

segment.description: Legacy timeline entry (no "type"). The first provides the starting position via "at"; later ones need a "to".

duration.description: Seconds of travel. Omitted = derived from distance.

hold.description: Seconds to dwell after arriving. Default 0.8 on the first and last, else 0.6.

stepStart.description: Where the timeline begins. First entry only; one is synthesized (at: "top") if the timeline starts with anything else.

hold.description: Seconds to dwell before moving. Default 0.8.

url.description: Pins where the timeline begins — stamped by authoring tools. Must agree with (or replace) the top-level url.

duration.description: Seconds of travel. Omitted = derived from distance.

hold.description: Seconds to dwell after arriving. Default 0.6 (0.8 on the last step).

stepClick.description: Click an element (must be in view). Forces jobs: 1.

settle.description: Seconds to let the page react. Default 0.6.

stepHover.description: Hover an element (must be in view). Forces jobs: 1.

settle.description: Seconds to let the page react. Default 0.6.

stepWait.description: Part of the format, not executable yet — parses, then is rejected with a clear message.

stepRecord.description: A recorded gesture, captured by an authoring tool and replayed verbatim through Chrome's input pipeline. Forces jobs: 1.

samples.description: Parallel arrays, one entry per sample.

x.description: Pointer x in viewport CSS px.

y.description: Pointer y in viewport CSS px.

buttons.description: Sparse left-button edges, chronological; the first must be "down".

smoothing.description: Opt-in cursor smoothing: resolve the pointer path through a zero-phase Gaussian kernel. true means strength 0.5. Pinned to the raw positions at button edges and the take's ends; scroll is never smoothed.

viewport.description: The viewport this was recorded at. A render at a different size is refused — breakpoints make it a different page.

hold.description: Seconds to dwell after the replay ends. Default 0.

t.description: ms from recording start; must fall inside the samples.
